# Notes — pylint #4604 (unused-import false positive for module used in type comment)

## Repro (proven)
`C:/Windows/Temp/a.py`: `import abc` / `from abc import ABC` / `X = ...  # type: abc.ABC` / `Y = ...  # type: ABC`
→ `W0611: Unused import abc` (line 3). Env: venv at
C:/Users/agent/work/projects/stack/campaign/.venv, astroid 2.6.5, run with
`PYTHONPATH=.` from C:/Users/agent/work/work/pylint-4604-panel.

## Root cause (proven via astroid parse)
`VariablesChecker._store_type_annotation_node` (pylint/checkers/variables.py ~L1823):
- `# type: ABC` → astroid `Name` → handled (name stored in `_type_annotation_names`).
- `# type: abc.ABC` → astroid **Attribute** (expr=Name('abc'), attrname='ABC').
  Function only handles `Name` and `Subscript`; an `Attribute` falls through and
  returns without storing anything → `abc` counted unused in `_check_imports`
  (L2033: `imported_name in self._type_annotation_names`).
- The typing special-case inside the `Subscript` branch already assumes
  `Attribute` has `.expr` (`type_annotation.value.expr`), so `Attribute.expr`
  exists in this astroid.

## Fix (minimal, in _store_type_annotation_node)
Add an `Attribute` branch: if `type_annotation.expr` is a `Name`, append its name
(e.g. `abc`), then also walk `nodes_of_class(Name)` for the rest of the chain
(covers `a.b.C` → stores `a` and `b`). Keep existing Name/Subscript behavior.
No test changes; no commit.
